observation.visible_scene: Against a fully black background, a silhouetted hand grips the left edge of a flat circular disc that has a hole in its center (spindle hole). Bright light passing through/reflecting off the disc produces a vivid rainbow diffraction pattern of concentric colored bands (white-yellow outer ring, cyan, blue-purple, dark inner zone). A tiny isolated blue speck of light sits at the right side of the frame throughout.
visible_changes: The diffraction pattern continuously morphs: in the early frames (t=0–~0.7s) it is a set of fairly uniform concentric colored rings; from ~t=0.8s onward the rings break apart and green/red/orange hues appear at the top, then the colored light reorganizes into two separate rainbow arcs on the left and right sides with dark gaps above and below (mid-clip, ~t=1.3–2.1s); by the last frames (~t=2.2–2.7s) the pattern re-forms into concentric rings again.

The apparent shape of the central hole changes from an irregular, slightly angular outline in the early frames to a rounder, more oval outline later, consistent with a change in the disc's tilt/orientation relative to the camera.

The hand silhouette and the disc's overall position within the frame stay roughly constant (no large translation); the dominant change is the shifting color pattern on the disc surface, not the disc moving across the scene.
The small blue speck on the right remains at a fixed position across all frames.
outside_clip_unknowns: What light source or motion of the light causes the diffraction pattern to shift, and whether the hand is actively tilting/rotating the disc or the camera/light is moving.
What happens before t=0 and after the last frame; both ends are arbitrary crop boundaries.
uncertain_details: Whether the pattern morphing is due to disc tilt, a moving light source, or camera angle change cannot be distinguished from the black background alone; the disc outline's near-constant position argues against large camera translation.
The exact material of the disc is not confirmable; only its rainbow diffractive appearance is visible.
